answer: Escrowed escrow-reply liveness. Each identity must answer a random per-epoch beacon from a validator subset within a tight window or forfeit a deposit sized to the audit cost; clones fail because Sybil operators cannot staff replies for every duplicate. The check inspects a latency kernel fitted to reply timestamps, so cloned replies cluster and trip rejection. That binding loss creates a karst-like sink of per-clone capital no attacker recovers.
